test.findings_en_raw: The thyroid gland is normal in size and morphology. A hypoechoic nodule measuring approximately _2DS_ is seen in the midportion of the right lobe, with well-defined margins and regular morphology. CDFI reveals no detectable blood flow signal. The remaining thyroid parenchyma demonstrates homogeneous echogenicity, with no abnormal intraparenchymal blood flow signal on CDFI. Scanning of the bilateral neck reveals multiple oval hypoechoic nodules in the right neck, with well-defined margins and relatively regular morphology. The “lymphatic hilum” is not visualized, and the cortex is mildly thickened. A small amount of blood flow signal is detectable on CDFI. One in the right supraclavicular region measures approximately _2DS_, and one in right cervical level III measures approximately _2DS_.
